topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes on cancer evolution, the microenvironment, and Darwinian selection, outlining the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Dynamics in Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how clonal expansion and competitive fitness driven by genetic mutations are complemented by non-mutational epigenetic and transcriptional changes.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate whether malignant transformation originates within tissue-specific stem cells or committed progenitor cells across different tissue hierarchies.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: They demonstrate that malignant outgrowth and persistence require supportive microenvironmental signals and chronic inflammation alongside oncogenic mutations.

topics.label: Methodologies for Investigating Cancer Evolution and Spatial Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the laboratory, computational, and spatial profiling technologies used to map mutational timing and tumor-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes how genetic, epigenetic, cellular, and microenvironmental factors interact within an evolutionary framework to permit cancer progression.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Preview
topics.groupedBecause: It marks the end of the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on cancer therapy.
